== Strategy ==

A very basic deck using the retrieval of SFS. Battle whereever possible, lose a few TIEs, send 1 to Return To Base and another to used pile. Use Commander Brandei to search for TIEs each turn, that way you get more retrieval. All the planets are parsec 4-8, that way I can just let Admiral Chiraneu sit at a parsec 6 and add 1 to drain where my other SDs are. Fel is used to add to battle destiny and DS-181-4 is used to react. To get the systems, rely on Admiral Piett to pull Commander Merrjyk (could pull Brandei if I want him to). For some large retrieval later in the game, use Short-range Fighters. I'm thinking about adding another Imp Command and dropping a Limited Resources.
